articles.summary: By integrating Horizon’s software infrastructure with AQT’s trapped-ion quantum computing systems, this collaboration helps accelerate progress towards real-world quantum applications.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum and AQT to Advance Real-World Quantum Applications with Strategic Hardware–Software Collaboration

articles.summary: Horizon Quantum will purchase one of IonQ’s first 6th-generation, chip-based 256-qubit trapped-ion systems, in furtherance of Horizon Quantum’s mission to unlock the full potential of quantum computing with its software platform.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum and IonQ Enter into Strategic Agreement to Unlock Quantum Potential

articles.summary: Horizon Quantum anticipates releasing its financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, on Tuesday, May 5, 2026, before the financial markets open.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum to Report First Quarter Financial Results on May 5, 2026
